title: 第15章 您这是性骚扰得加钱第16章 我引荐你去卖屁股吧
slug: 人在美利坚我的叔叔堂吉诃德
content_zh:
“不是兄弟，”迈克尔痛心疾首地看着李维，“你偷偷告诉我，你是不是打药了？”
第二天一大早，李维就来到了健身房，兴致勃勃地准备测试一下自己的力量。
他听说卧推100公斤对于绝大多数的健身爱好者来说都是一个不大不小的门槛，他想试试看今天能不能一口气突破这道关卡。
令他没想到的是之前在健身房认识的黑人同学迈克尔居然今天也来的这么早。
询问之后，李维才知道他今天下午也有兼职要做，所以只能赶在今天早上上学之前来练一练。
练着练着，迈克尔就感觉不对劲了。
哥们前天才能尽力推一次80公斤，怎么今天推80公斤就TM跟推空气一样？！
疑惑之下，他下意识的就以为李维是不是为了追求进步的速度而偷偷打了药。
“别想那种有的没的，”李维拍了拍他的肩膀，“我可没打药。”
“那你前天是不是在逗我？”迈克尔无论如何都不能相信李维的进步速度这么快，“你这是超人吧？每天晒太阳就能变强，吸收太阳辐射来的？”
李维心底也好奇这个系统的极限在哪里，是不是有朝一日自己真的可以成为超人。
不过此刻他只是一个弱不禁风的17岁少年，拥有系统才不过一周左右的时间，现在还没办法考虑不吃牛肉的问题。
“少说废话，”李维笑道，“帮我装片。”
“加到多少？”迈克尔说道，“今天状态好，要不要试试90公斤？”
李维摇摇头，“直接上到100公斤吧，”他说道，“我试试。”
“你能推100公斤那是真的牛逼了兄弟，”迈克尔和他碰了碰拳，把杠铃加到100公斤，“来吧，我在背后辅助你。”
...
“不是，你说100就100啊！”
迈克尔看着李维稳稳地推起100公斤，甚至后面110公斤都推起来了之后，他彻底有点绷不住了。
“我服了，”他拉着李维的衣服，“你用的什么药？能不能带我一个，我求你了，你别练了，你真别练了。”

李维心知迈克尔只是在耍宝而已，跟他开了几句玩笑后，来到深蹲架面前测试了一下自己的深蹲极限。
深蹲的力量涨幅也相当喜人，从95公斤直线上升到140公斤。
从现在开始李维才感觉自己的身体素质似乎已经可以达到进入高中橄榄球队的标准了。
他很期待3个多星期之后入学，他的身体素质会增长到怎么样一个不可思议的地步。
练到接近9点的时候，迈克尔和李维一起离开了健身房，分道扬镳。
李维要先回家换一趟衣服再去上东区兼职，迈克尔则是要去赶着上学。
身材和力量的变化不仅仅只有他自己发现，德洛丽丝夫人也发现了。
“这套西服似乎小了点，”她看着李维说道，“你吃胖了？里面又穿了什么？”
content_en:
"No brother," Michael looked at Levi sadly, "Tell me secretly, did you take medicine?"
Early the next morning, Levi came to the gym, excitedly preparing to test his strength.
He heard that bench pressing 100 kilograms was a moderate threshold for most fitness enthusiasts, and he wanted to try to see if he could break through this barrier in one go today.
What he didn't expect was that Michael, a black classmate he had met in the gym, would come so early today.
After asking, Levi learned that he also had a part-time job to do this afternoon, so he could only come and practice before going to school this morning.
As he continued practicing, Michael felt something was wrong.
Dude, I could push 80 kilograms as hard as I could the day before yesterday. How come pushing 80 kilograms today is like pushing air? !
Under doubt, he subconsciously thought that Levi secretly took the medicine in order to pursue the speed of progress.
"Don't think about it," Levi patted him on the shoulder, "I didn't use any medicine."
"Then were you kidding me the day before yesterday?" Michael couldn't believe Levi's progress so fast. "Are you Superman? You can become stronger by being in the sun every day and absorbing solar radiation?"
Levi was also curious in his heart about the limits of this system, and whether he could really become Superman one day.
But at the moment, he is just a frail 17-year-old boy. He has only had the system for about a week, and he can't think about not eating beef yet.
"Stop talking nonsense," Levi said with a smile, "Help me install the film."
"How much?" Michael said, "I'm in good condition today. Do you want to try 90 kilograms?"
Levi shook his head, "Just go up to 100 kilograms," he said, "I'll give it a try."
"You are really awesome if you can push 100 kilograms, brother." Michael bumped fists with him and increased the barbell to 100 kilograms. "Come on, I will help you from behind."
...
"No, you said 100, it's 100!"
Michael watched Levi push up 100 kilograms steadily, and even after pushing up the next 110 kilograms, he couldn't hold it anymore.
"I've taken it." He pulled on Levi's clothes. "What medicine did you use? Can you bring me one? I beg you, stop practicing. You really don't want to practice."
Levi knew that Michael was just playing tricks, so after making a few jokes with him, he came to the squat rack to test his squat limit.
The increase in squat strength is also quite gratifying, rising straight from 95 kilograms to 140 kilograms.
From now on, Levi feels that his physical fitness has reached the standard for entering the high school football team.
He is looking forward to enrolling in school in more than three weeks and seeing how incredible his physical fitness will be.
When practice approached 9 o'clock, Michael and Levi left the gym together and went their separate ways.
Levi had to go home and change before going to work part-time on the Upper East Side, while Michael had to rush to school.
The changes in stature and strength were noticed not only by himself, but also by Mrs. Dolores.
"This suit seems a little too small," she looked at Levi and said, "Have you gained weight? What are you wearing underneath?"
